title: sh.fx extensions to the Agent Client Protocol, version 1
description: Draft. The types that sh-fx.md defines. The standard ACP types are in acp/v1/schema.json.

MethodName.description: The name of an sh.fx method or notification: `_sh.fx/` followed by `<area>/<action>` in snake_case.

CapabilityName.description: The name of an sh.fx capability: `sh.fx/` followed by a camelCase name.

MetaKey.description: An sh.fx key in a `_meta` object: `sh.fx/` followed by a camelCase name.

Capability.description: The value of an sh.fx capability entry. It stays empty unless the extension defines options. Peers ignore fields they don't know.

AgentCapabilitiesMeta.description: The sh.fx entries that fx lists in `agentCapabilities._meta` of its `initialize` response.

ClientCapabilitiesMeta.description: The sh.fx entries that a client lists in `clientCapabilities._meta` of its `initialize` request.

PromptDeliveryCapability.description: The value of the sh.fx/promptDelivery capability that fx lists: one entry for each delivery that fx supports.

PromptDelivery.description: The value of sh.fx/delivery in the `_meta` of a `session/prompt` request: what fx does with a prompt that arrives while a turn runs.

SteeringDelivery.description: The value of sh.fx/steeringDelivery in the `_meta` of the response to a steer: whether the running turn took the steer, or the steer ran in the next turn.

SteerInput.description: The value of sh.fx/steerInput in the `_meta` of a `user_message_chunk` update that shows a steer.

requestId.description: The request id of the `session/prompt` that sent the steer, or null for a host steer.

inputId.description: The input id of a host steer.

LogPosition.description: A position in a session's log, which names the last turn saved. Opaque: a client stores it and sends it back unchanged.

ReplayFrom.description: The value of sh.fx/replayFrom in the `_meta` of a `session/load` request: replay only the turns saved after this position.

Replay.description: The value of sh.fx/replay in the `_meta` of a `session/load` response: whether fx replayed the turns after the position, or the whole session because it didn't know the position.

ClientId.description: The id that fx gives a connection when it connects: sh.fx/clientId in the `_meta` of the `initialize` response, sh.fx/client in the `_meta` of a `user_message_chunk` from another client, and the `clientId` of a session client. Opaque.

SessionClient.description: One client that has the session open: its id, and the `clientInfo` it sent at `initialize`, which follows ACP's `Implementation`.

ClientsUpdateParams.description: The params of the `_sh.fx/session/clients_update` notification: every client that has the session open.

SessionState.description: The value of sh.fx/state in the `_meta` of a `session/status` response and of a `session/list` row, and the `state` of a session state update: what the session is doing.

SessionStateUpdate.description: The `update` of `_sh.fx/session/state_update`: the states of ACP's `StateUpdate` that fx sends. ACP v2 sends the same object as a `state_update`.

stopReason.description: With `idle` after a turn: the turn's stopReason, one of ACP's StopReason values.

ListChangedParams.description: The params of the `_sh.fx/session/list_changed` notification: the folder whose list of sessions changed.

cwd.description: The absolute folder of the session that changed.
